email.subject: Your forecasting project on GitHub
email.body:
Hi,

I lead the machine learning team at Kelpwave. I found your time-series forecasting project on GitHub and really liked how you structured the evaluation.

We're hiring a Machine Learning Engineer to work on demand forecasting for our marketplace. If you're open to new opportunities, I'd love to tell you more about the role.

Thanks,
Arjun Mehta
ML Lead, Kelpwave
